title: Edit a prompt in Settings › AI › Prompts, see r1 and the changes, then reset
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData, open Settings › AI and choose the Prompts tab
Edit One-line summary, change a sentence, press Save my version
Open the Changes and History tabs
expected: Every prompt is listed with its id and version. After Save the row says Edited · r1 and the id line shows +r1 with a digest; Changes marks your lines with + and the old ones with −; History lists r1 with Revert. After Reset the row has no badge, the editor shows the default and History still lists r1.
